prompt_text: I need a dental implant in Atlanta. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need one quick detail: what ZIP code or neighborhood in Atlanta (or how far you’re willing to travel inside the metro area)? Also tell me briefly what type of implant you think you need (single tooth, multiple, full-arch/All-on-4, need extractions or bone grafting, or you don’t know). With that I’ll call out 4–6 specific, reputable practices nearby and explain why each is a good choice.

While you reply, here’s how I’ll choose practices and what to look for when you call them:

How I’ll select practices for you
- Specialists first: board-certified oral & maxillofacial surgeons, board-certified periodontists, and prosthodontists experienced in implants for complex prosthetic work.  
- Teams that offer multi-disciplinary care on-site (surgeon + prosthodontist) for better implant-to-crown results.  
- Modern diagnostic and treatment technology: CBCT (3D X‑ray), digital implant planning/guided surgery, and on-site lab or strong lab partnerships.  
- High procedure volume and clear experience with your type of case (single crown vs full-arch).  
- Clear pricing/financing options and documented follow-up/warranty policies.  
- Good patient reviews, before/after cases, and verifiable credentials (AAOMS/ABOMS, AAP, AACD, American Academy of Implant Dentistry).

Questions to ask when you call (short script)
1. “Do you place dental implants for [single tooth / multiple / full-arch]? How many of that type do you do per year?”  
2. “Are you board-certified? Which specialty (oral surgeon, periodontist, prosthodontist) will be doing the implant and who will restore the crown?”  
3. “Do you do CBCT scans and digital guided implant planning in-house?”  
4. “Will you handle bone grafting/sinus lifts if needed, or refer out?”  
5. “What implant brand(s) do you use (Straumann, Nobel, Zimmer, etc.) and do you offer an implant warranty?”  
6. “Do you offer sedation or IV sedation if I’m anxious?”  
7. “Can I see before/after photos and patient references for cases like mine?”  
8. “What is the total cost estimate and what financing or payment plans do you offer?”

If you want, give me your ZIP code or neighborhood now and whether you prefer a periodontist/oral surgeon/prosthodontist or a one-stop implant center, and I’ll return a short list of specific practices to call with a one-line reason for each.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
